$comment: Case files (Phase 2). Structure only; all wording lives in messages under caseFiles.items.<id>. Only status "approved" renders publicly. An approved case needs: evidence files sanitized and approved in src/assets/evidence/manifest.json and registered in src/content/evidence-images.ts, at least one finding tied to its evidence, every message in en/he/ar, updatedOn and approvedOn. Provenance is always personal-lab. Video is optional and must be an own recording with captions in all three languages. Run npm run check:content.
